name: com.agentloopr/website
title: Agent Loopr
description: Agent Loopr's services, case studies and booking link, for AI agents helping founders.

tools.name: agentloopr_get_company
tools.description: Return Agent Loopr identity, when-to-use guidance, contact, markets served and NAP so an agent can describe the studio accurately.

tools.name: agentloopr_list_services
tools.description: List Agent Loopr's services with URLs: SaaS Products, Agentic Systems, Vibe Code Rescue, and Business Brain (a team assistant built on a company's own files, with an international and an India page).

tools.name: agentloopr_list_case_studies
tools.description: List published Agent Loopr case studies with client name, service line, outcome numbers and URL.

tools.name: agentloopr_get_page
tools.description: Fetch the markdown representation of a public Agent Loopr page. Pass a root-relative path such as /, /services/saas, /about, or /case-studies/blue-nelumbo.

tools.name: agentloopr_book_call
tools.description: Get the link where a person books a free call with Agent Loopr, and what to have ready. It returns a link only: it never books, holds or changes a meeting. A person always picks the time themselves.

interest.description: What the person wants to talk about, if known. Only used to tag the link so we can see which service the call is about.
